note: A synthetic but realistic practice call used by `npm run demo` so the full pipeline can be exercised with no credentials. Replace with a real transcript once calls are flowing.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Hi, yeah, is this Twin Home Buyer? I got a card in the mail about a property I inherited over in San Mateo. I'm just trying to figure out what my options are.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Yes sir, this is Marcus with Twin Home Buyer. Thanks for calling in. Tell me about the property.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Well it was my mom's place. She passed in January. It's a little three bedroom on the east side, she lived there since the seventies. I've been driving over there every couple weeks just to check on it and honestly I'm getting tired of it.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear about your mom. How long has it been sitting empty?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Since March. We cleaned it out in February and it's just been sitting there since.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Got it. And what's driving you to look at selling it now rather than renting it out?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: I don't want to be a landlord. I'm forty minutes away, I've got my own job, and every time I go over there something else is wrong. Last time it was a sprinkler line.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That makes sense. What's the condition like overall? Is the kitchen original?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Oh yeah, it's all original. Kitchen's from the eighties I'd say. One bathroom, and that bathroom needs work, the tile's cracked. Roof is old, probably twenty years. Yard's a mess.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Okay. And how many bedrooms and bathrooms, and do you know the square footage?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Three bedroom, one bathroom. I think it's around eleven, twelve hundred square feet.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Perfect. So the way we work is we buy as-is, cash, no repairs, no commissions, and we can close on your timeline. What were you hoping to get for it?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Well, I looked it up and Zillow says it's worth about one point one. That's kind of what I had in my head.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Yeah, so Zillow is going to be based on updated homes in the area. With the roof and the bathroom and everything original, we'd be somewhere south of that. Probably more in the nine hundreds.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Nine hundreds? That seems low to me. I've had a couple other people call about it too, and an agent said she could list it.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Sure, and she might be able to. But you'd be looking at commissions, you'd have to do the repairs, and it could sit for a couple months. With us you're done in two weeks and you never go back over there.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: I hear you. I'm really not in a rush though.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Understood. Is there any kind of timeline you're working with at all?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Not really. I mean, sometime this year. It'd be nice to have it done, but there's no deadline.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Okay. Well let me run some numbers on my end and see what we can do. Are there any liens or anything on the property that you know of?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Not that I know of. It went through probate and that closed a couple months ago.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Good, that's the main thing. So what I'd like to do is get out there and take a look, or if that's easier, you could walk me through on video. Would tomorrow work?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: What do you need to come out for? Can't you just give me a number over the phone?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I can give you a range, but to give you a real number that I'll actually stand behind at closing, I need eyes on it. Otherwise I'd be renegotiating later and I don't want to do that to you.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Alright, that's fair. Tomorrow's not great, I work. What about Thursday?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thursday works. How about two o'clock? I'll come to you and it'll take twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Two o'clock Thursday. Okay, yeah, that works.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Great, I'll put you down for Thursday at two. Is this the best number to reach you?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Yeah this is my cell. Alright, I'll see you Thursday.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Sounds good Larry, talk to you then.
